latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Video from Photo (v1.0.0).
- Turn photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) into 1080p animated MP4 videos; supports files up to 200MB.
- Provides simple authentication: automatically retrieves a free token if not set.
- Fast cloud processing (30-60 seconds per video), with auto session management.
- Includes support for smooth transitions, background music, and timeline text overlays.
- Guides users through uploading, editing, exporting video, and checking credits or session status.
